concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity first-person AR glasses HUD concept for the Helmetd project, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: create a polished, restrained HUD UI concept named "01 / QUIET SPATIAL". This is an actual UI design exploration, not a picture of glasses, a helmet, a website, or a laptop screen.
Scene/backdrop: first-person view into a real, uncluttered electronics workshop. A workbench with a small Raspberry Pi and camera module sits ahead at about eye level, neutral grey surfaces, soft daylight. Keep the environment gently subdued so the HUD reads crisply, but objects remain recognizable.
UI design: subtle off-white text with a single pale cyan accent, crisp modern sans-serif typography, medium readable font sizes, short labels, generous spacing, disciplined thin linework, almost no glow. UI occupies roughly 20% of the image; keep the central view mostly open. The display floats over the real scene; no large opaque panels.
Composition: a tiny 'helmetd' wordmark at the upper left; an elegant compact status row at upper right with a green dot and the exact labels 'PI ONLINE', 'Wi-Fi', and '82%'. One precise spatial anchor associated with the camera module on the workbench: four small corner marks hugging that object, a short fine leader to a floating two-line label reading 'Camera module' and 'Anchor 01 · 1.8 m'. This should look anchored to the physical scene. At bottom center, a slim rounded translucent voice strip with a tiny waveform, the word 'Listening', and one line 'What would you like to inspect?'. A small lower-left label 'WORLD LOCKED' with a restrained orientation icon.
Outside the usable HUD area, include only a small clean caption in the bottom margin: '01 / QUIET SPATIAL' and 'helmetd — HUD concept'. The caption is presentation framing, not product UI.
Constraints: one coherent full-screen concept, highly legible typography, professional interface craft, intentional hierarchy. Render only the requested labels. No code, menus, long paragraphs, buttons, widgets, timestamps, random numbers, dashboard cards, eye reticles, weapon targeting, helmets, glasses frames, decorative sci-fi rings, fake holographic grids, huge borders, marketing headings, or watermarks.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity first-person AR glasses HUD concept for the Helmetd project, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: create a polished HUD UI design exploration named "02 / INSTRUMENT". Show a more technical, precise, information-rich alternative for a user testing a camera/sensor rig. It must still be practical and calm, not a busy science-fiction movie interface.
Scene/backdrop: first-person view of a real uncluttered electronics workshop workbench, with a small Raspberry Pi and camera module on it, neutral grey materials and slightly dim soft daylight. Show the actual environment full-bleed behind the interface. No laptop screen, browser, glasses or helmet visible.
Visual design: warm white typography with restrained amber accents, slim squared-off corner brackets instead of rounded glass cards, structured monospaced numerals paired with a clean sans-serif, minimal glow. Technical instrument aesthetics, clear alignment and breathing room. Roughly 65% of the view remains completely unobstructed, especially its center.
Composition and exact content: upper left tiny 'helmetd' and 'FIELD VIEW'; upper right a compact horizontal indicator strip 'PI ONLINE' · 'Wi-Fi' · '82%'. A narrow left-edge text rail headed 'TELEMETRY' containing three neatly spaced rows: 'Camera  ACTIVE', 'Tracking  LOCKED', 'Link  STABLE'. Keep these as typography and hairline separators, not boxed dashboard cards. On the right edge, a single small readout 'ANCHOR 01' and '1.8 m', with a fine leader line terminating at a very small amber square aligned to the camera module on the physical bench. A restrained short compass tick strip at top center with 'N' and 'NE' only, leaving the middle open. Bottom center a low narrow voice response band containing a simple audio waveform and the exact text 'Helmetd' above 'Camera connected. Tracking is stable.' Bottom left a tiny 'VOICE ACTIVE' indicator.
A clean small caption in the bottom outer margin reads '02 / INSTRUMENT' and 'helmetd — HUD concept'; this is presentation framing outside the product UI.
Constraints: high-end UI concept with intentional hierarchy and easily readable text, subtle additive overlay over the scene, no large opaque panels. Render only the requested text. No targeting reticle, weapons, radar, health bars, fake performance numbers, decorative circles, floating cube graphics, neon cyan sci-fi clutter, random labels, web UI chrome, giant headings or watermarks.
